verdict: No outstanding blocker in the reviewed PowerShell bootstrap and Cursor contract scope.
review_scope: Cursor -Profile/-Status/-Cancel contract and unique per-task paths under profile/.preprocess.
PowerShell 5.1 source syntax/API compatibility, UTF-8 BOM source and UTF-16LE BOM status.

resolved_findings.finding: A descendant retaining redirected output could outlive the direct child and block unconditional output drain.
resolved_findings.resolution: Removed unconditional WaitForExit and bounded output drain; actual extracted function regression returned within its probe budget.

resolved_findings.finding: ExternalAttributes is unavailable on pre-4.7.2 .NET Framework and direct access under StrictMode could reject valid archives.
resolved_findings.resolution: Guard property existence; pinned archive hash, exact flat whitelist and manual regular-file creation remain mandatory.

additional_final_fix_reviewed: File.Replace null backup uses NullString.Value; Microsoft lists NullString as a Windows PowerShell 5.1 accelerator and API.
execution_policy: Launcher uses only process-local -ExecutionPolicy Bypass for its fixed packaged script. No Set-ExecutionPolicy or registry/user/machine policy change; enforced Group Policy remains authoritative.
limits: Independent actual PowerShell regression used Linux PowerShell 7.4.6, not native Windows PowerShell 5.1.
